messages.subject: Martin | Director-Level External Affairs, ESG & Energy Transition Executive
messages.body:
Dear Mr Klacián,

I am reaching out because your recruitment role at CEZ makes you a relevant contact for senior international profiles aligned with the Group's energy-transition and sustainability agenda.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major mining operation undergoing substantial capital investment and renewable-energy development.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest fit is in leadership roles where public institutions, energy transition, sustainability, reputation and disciplined cross-functional execution meet.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Corporate Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached a CEZ-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates, or referral to the appropriate senior hiring lead within the Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
